matched_queries: UK employment guidance: Employers informing workers of their right to join a trade union, including required written information.
Discover UK employment guidance for Informing workers of their right to join a union. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
From January 1 2027, employers must inform workers of their right to join a trade union.

This guidance explains:

how to prepare a statement to inform workers of their right to join a trade union

when you must inform workers

how to give the statement to workers

what to do if the location or details of the statement change
